tool: CrossRef REST API (api.crossref.org) + CrossRef bibliographic title search
method: Every DOI used as an anchor was extracted with its surrounding usage context (repo id, citation string, chemistry/matrix family, notes). CrossRef metadata was fetched for each and compared against that context. MATCH = DOI resolves to the paper the context describes. METADATA-MISMATCH = right paper, wrong claimed author/year/venue/id. TOPIC-MISMATCH = DOI resolves to a live paper on a different subject than the anchor claims. DEAD = DOI does not resolve.
